# 📄 SERV Reasoning (BRAID as a service)
**document** · shared · knowledge

OpenServ ships BRAID as an inference API: every call runs through a generated bounded reasoning prompt; a Shadow Agent validates inside the call; a raw-mode header turns the layer off; the caller never sees the graph. Read 2026-09-12 from docs.openserv.ai, not run. The lab's rule: one seat of the dual-agent loop, never both, never the default; the Shadow Agent is not the Gap; the vendor console is REPORTED tier.
